title: Numa Files
subtitle: Browse and manage your files and folders

empty.title: No folders yet
empty.message: Create your first folder to start organizing files

createFolder.title: Create New Folder
createFolder.nameHelp: Choose a descriptive name for your folder.
createFolder.typePersonalHelp: Only you will have access to this folder.
createFolder.typeSharedHelp: Share this folder with specific users who can view or edit.
createFolder.viewersPlaceholder: Type an email or ID and press Add/Enter
createFolder.viewersHelp: Editors are automatically included as viewers.
createFolder.editorsPlaceholder: Type an email or ID and press Add/Enter
createFolder.editorsHelp: Editors can upload files and modify this folder; they automatically gain viewer access.

notes.creator: You will be set as the creator and automatically added as an editor.
notes.personal: Personal folders: Only you have access.
notes.shared: Shared folders: Specify viewers (can query) and editors (can upload/modify). Editors automatically have viewer permissions.
notes.isolation: Files uploaded to this folder are isolated from other folders.

errors.nameRequired: Please provide a name for the folder.
errors.editorsMustBeViewers: Editors must also be viewers for shared folders.

folderSettings.title: Folder Settings
folderSettings.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this folder? This action cannot be undone.
folderSettings.deleteWarning: This will permanently delete this folder configuration. Files will remain in storage but will no longer be associated with this folder.

webCrawler.destinationHint: Crawled content will be added to this folder.

shared.title: Shared Files
shared.subtitle: Share files and create drop zones for external document collection.
shared.hint: File sharing and drop zones will be available here.

sharing.title: Document Sharing
sharing.description: Share files with external users via a secure link. Visitors can view, download, and ask AI questions about the document.

dropZone.title: Drop Zones
dropZone.description: Create an upload link for external users to submit files to you. Great for collecting documents, reports, or submissions.

remote.title: Remote Files
remote.subtitle: Connect to external file providers to browse and import files.
remote.comingSoon: Remote file browsing will be available here.
remote.connectProvider: Connect a provider from Data Connectors to get started.

rootFiles.title: My Files
rootFiles.empty: No loose files. Upload files here or create a folder to organise them.

upload.title: Upload Files to {{name}}
upload.body: Files will be automatically indexed and made available for querying in Numa Chat.
upload.note: Maximum file size is 50MB per file.

largeFile.title: Large Raw Data File Detected
largeFile.description: You are about to upload large raw data files that may not be optimal for indexing:
largeFile.warning: This can incur higher than expected cost, or may fail to index successfully.
largeFile.recommendation: For better performance, consider breaking large raw data files into smaller chunks.
largeFile.confirm: Do you want to proceed with uploading these files anyway?

search.truncatedTooltip: Search covers the first 50,000 files — open a subfolder for the rest

move.collision: One or more files already exist at the destination. Rename or delete them first.
move.cannotEditDest: You don't have permission to move files here.
